message.content: {"note_claim": "Cigarettes contain far more diacetyl than e-cigarettes and never caused popcorn lung.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Prior research into tobacco cigarettes (which contain measurably higher levels of diacetyl and are more commonly used than e-cigarettes) determined that smoking is not a risk factor for popcorn lung, so the lower concentrations of diacetyl in e-cigarette juices are not likely a risk factor in popcorn lung.", "reason": "The page directly states that tobacco cigarettes contain higher levels of diacetyl than e-cigarettes and that smoking has not been shown to be a risk factor for popcorn lung, substantiating the note's core claims."}

parsed.note_claim: Cigarettes contain far more diacetyl than e-cigarettes and never caused popcorn lung.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Prior research into tobacco cigarettes (which contain measurably higher levels of diacetyl and are more commonly used than e-cigarettes) determined that smoking is not a risk factor for popcorn lung, so the lower concentrations of diacetyl in e-cigarette juices are not likely a risk factor in popcorn lung.
parsed.reason: The page directly states that tobacco cigarettes contain higher levels of diacetyl than e-cigarettes and that smoking has not been shown to be a risk factor for popcorn lung, substantiating the note's core claims.
